seo.title: Ray-Ban: AI-automated TikTok buying (Smart+) - +42% ROAS, -50% CPA (2025)
seo.meta_description: Ray-Ban switched its TikTok sales campaigns to Smart+ Catalog Ads: ROAS +42%, CPA -50%, and conversion rate +47% vs manual management.
seo.resume_citable: Ray-Ban ran its sales campaigns on TikTok via Smart+ Catalog Ads (AI-driven media buying) and achieved 42% higher ROAS, a 50% lower CPA, and a 47% higher conversion rate compared with manual management.

faq.q: What is TikTok Smart+ Catalog Ads?
faq.a: TikTok's automated format: the advertiser supplies its catalog and an objective, the AI manages targeting, bidding, placements, and creative selection, and dynamically serves the right product to each user.

faq.q: Does the AI create Ray-Ban's advertising?
faq.a: No. In this case, the AI optimizes and automates media buying (bidding, targeting, budget). It is optimization, not creative generation.

pattern: fully automated paid campaign (bidding, targeting, placement) connected to the product catalog

stack_technique.detail: TikTok automated campaign: targeting, bidding, placements, and creative selection managed by AI from the catalog.
TikTok's AI suite cited in the case's stack.
Product feed (eyewear) connected to TikTok to dynamically serve the right item to each user.
Conversion signal (purchase) reported to the platform; without it, optimization runs blind.

objectif_business: Sell eyewear directly during the US summer peak without multiplying manual campaign management, by letting TikTok automation seek buyers and serve catalog products.
description: Ray-Ban ran its sales campaigns on TikTok via Smart+ Catalog Ads, TikTok's automated format. The advertiser supplies the product catalog and a performance objective; the platform's AI manages targeting, bidding, placements, and creative selection, then dynamically serves the right product to each user. Ray-Ban activated this approach in the US market during the summer months, a period of high demand for sunglasses. Compared with manual management, the switch to automation produced a 50 percent lower cost per acquisition, a 47 percent higher conversion rate, and 42 percent higher ROAS. This is a case of media-buying optimization and automation, not creative generation: the AI arbitrates budget and targeting, it does not build the ad.
points_cles: Fully AI-automated sales campaign connected to the product catalog.
TikTok Smart+ Catalog Ads tool, with the Symphony suite and the pixel.
ROAS up 42%, CPA down 50%, conversion up 47%.
Evidence B, status confirmed on a standard TikTok product.

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified TikTok platform case study citing Ray-Ban and its Performance Marketing Manager by name; interested official source, hence B. The Smart+ product is confirmed by TikTok's launch announcement.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Continuous, in real time: bidding and targeting are recomputed on every impression over the whole campaign duration.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: The brand's acquisition / performance marketing team, which feeds the catalog and sets the objective; day-to-day arbitration is delegated to TikTok.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The conversion event reported to TikTok (purchase via pixel and CAPI). If the purchase signal is missing or poorly attributed, the AI optimizes blind and performance drops.

etapes.detail: The product feed (eyewear) is connected to TikTok to serve dynamic ads.
The brand sets a conversion or ROAS objective and a budget; the rest is left to Smart+.
The AI chooses audiences, placements, bids, and creatives, and serves the product suited to each user.
The team tracks ROAS and CPA, adjusts the budget and catalog, no longer micro-manages the bids.

prerequis_data: TikTok pixel + CAPI with a reliable purchase event
prerequis_orga: acceptance of ceding fine-grained control to automation
replication.premiere_etape: Connect the product catalog and the purchase event, then launch a Smart+ Catalog Ads campaign against a ROAS objective.

playbook.action: Connect the product catalog and the tracking (pixel + Events API) with a reliable purchase event.
playbook.livrable: Validated product feed and a purchase that reports into TikTok Ads.

playbook.action: Launch a Smart+ Catalog Ads campaign with a ROAS or conversion objective and a test budget.
Let the learning phase run, track ROAS and CPA without micro-managing the bids.
playbook.livrable: Stabilized read vs a reference manual campaign.

playbook.action: Arbitrate: scale the budget, adjust the catalog or the objective based on performance.
playbook.livrable: Budget decision and documented management rules.

replication.equipe: 1 media buyer + 1 e-commerce integrator for the catalog feed and the Events API.

statut_vivant.note: Smart+ is a standard product in the TikTok Ads catalog, enriched in 2025 (Advertising Week New York). The activation remains available and documented.

transposable_ue.note: Smart+ Catalog Ads is available in Europe. Targeting relies on TikTok signals and the product catalog, with no first-party data exported; limited GDPR exposure. Conversion tracking on the EU side requires consent mode and the TikTok CAPI properly configured.
